definitions.explanation: An official holiday designated by the government, when schools and most businesses are closed.

examples.japanese: ⟦{明日|あした}→明日：00501_ashita⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{祝日|しゅくじつ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{学校|がっこう}→学校：00055_gakkou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{休|やす}み→休み：02266_yasumi⟧だ。
examples.english: Tomorrow is a national holiday, so school is closed.

examples.japanese: ⟦{日本|にほん}→日本：03876_nihon⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{年間|ねんかん}→年間：00974_nenkan⟧16⟦{日|にち}→日：12732_nichi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{祝日|しゅくじつ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: Japan has 16 national holidays per year.

examples.japanese: {祝日|しゅくじつ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{日曜日|にちようび}→日曜日：00656_nichiyoubi⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{重|かさ}なる→重なる：02038_kasanaru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{振替|ふりかえ}{休日|きゅうじつ}→振替休日：15073_furikaekyuujitsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: When a national holiday falls on Sunday, the following Monday becomes a substitute holiday.

notes:
{祝日|しゅくじつ} means a national or public holiday ({祝|しゅく} celebration + {日|じつ} day). Japan has 16 per year, including ⟦{元日|がんじつ}→元日：00059_ganjitsu⟧ (New Year's Day), ⟦{成人|せいじん}→成人：03378_seijin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{日|ひ}→日：02249_hi⟧ (Coming of Age Day), こども⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{日|ひ}→日：02249_hi⟧ (Children's Day), and ⟦{文化|ぶんか}→文化：01504_bunka⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{日|ひ}→日：02249_hi⟧ (Culture Day).

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {祝日|しゅくじつ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{日曜日|にちようび}→日曜日：00656_nichiyoubi⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{重|かさ}なる→重なる：02038_kasanaru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{振替|ふりかえ}{休日|きゅうじつ}→振替休日：15073_furikaekyuujitsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧: when a holiday falls on Sunday, the following Monday becomes a substitute holiday

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{休日|きゅうじつ}→休日：03028_kyuujitsu⟧: day off, holiday (general, includes weekends)
- ⟦{振替休日|ふりかえきゅうじつ}→振替休日：15073_furikaekyuujitsu⟧: substitute holiday
- ⟦{連休|れんきゅう}→連休：07587_renkyuu⟧: consecutive holidays

REGISTER: Neutral; the formal term is ⟦{国民|こくみん}→国民：02757_kokumin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{祝日|しゅくじつ}.
